events.description: Render two side-by-side complex planes with distinct background grid colors and labels ('Root Plane' and 'Input/Coefficient Plane').
events.clip_query: Two side-by-side complex coordinate grids appearing on screen with labels.

events.description: Spawn interactive/moving dots on both planes: one input dot on the right plane, and two root dots on the left plane.
events.clip_query: Colored dots appearing on both the left and right complex planes.

events.description: Animate the input dot tracing a continuous circular path around the origin of its complex plane.
events.clip_query: A red dot tracing a circular path on the right complex plane.

events.description: Animate the two root dots on the left plane tracing out semi-circular paths, demonstrating they swap places as the input completes a full loop.
events.clip_query: Two yellow dots tracing semi-circles on the left complex plane, swapping positions.

events.description: Display continuous tracer lines (paths) behind all moving dots to clearly show the geometry of their trajectories.
events.clip_query: Fading or solid trail lines following the paths of the moving dots on both planes.
